item.powermod.storm_hammer.tooltip.ultra: Fully charge, then sneak + release: Ultracharge (30s cooldown)
item.powermod.staff_of_ancient_winds.too: Hold right-click: channel an ever-growing whirlwind where you look
After 5s it moves to your offhand and channels hands-free
Release, or take it out of your offhand: a final gust hurls everything away
item.powermod.staff_of_flight.tooltip.ta: While held: jump again in mid-air to take off
item.powermod.staff_of_flight.tooltip.fl: Hold forward to ride the wind; let go to drift down, sneak to descend
item.powermod.starfall_sceptre.tooltip.c: Hold right-click to mark a spot, release to call down meteors
item.powermod.starfall_sceptre.tooltip.n: Draws on the stars: much weaker in daylight
item.powermod.hourglass_of_stillness.too: Right-click: stop time around you for 5 seconds
Right-click again to let time go early
item.powermod.hourglass_of_eternity.tool: Right-click: stop time around you, wherever you go, for as long as you like
Right-click again to let time go
item.powermod.staff_of_drought.tooltip.c: Hold right-click: draw all moisture out of where you look
item.powermod.staff_of_drought.tooltip.w: Water and lava vanish, plants wither, soil cracks
